code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    bg=max(set(v for row in g for v in row), key=lambda v:sum(r.count(v) for r in g))
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=bg]
    if not pts:return g
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            if (r in (r0,r1) or c in (c0,c1)) and g[r][c]==bg:
                g[r][c]=2
    return g
'''
